purpose: Teach: マウンテン/ロハス/ベア/アルト/デュオ/ゴースト/オーソドックス/スピリット

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがマウンテンの絵本を読んで下さるわよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's going to read you that picture book about the mountain.
lines.style: Warm and gentle, lifting slightly on the offer. Present, attentive. The cadence of a mother already picturing her son's delight.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとロハスな野菜炒めを作ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I made that healthy vegetable stir-fry together today.
lines.style: Bright, proud announcement. Quick tempo, eager to share. Small-boy enthusiasm that expects to be celebrated. Slight lift at the end—seeking confirmation he did something good.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがクマのベア型ケーキを焼いて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad baked that bear-shaped cake for you.
lines.style: Soft, affectionate. A mother noticing and naming a small act of love. Gentle downward slope at the end, as if tucking the moment away.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとアルトサックスを聴いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I listened to alto saxophone music together.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly wondering tone. Slower than his previous lines—this one is about discovery, not just activity. Genuine discovery in his voice, not performing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと従姉妹さんがピアノのデュオをされるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad and your cousin are going to play a piano duet.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly distant—observing something beautiful happen. Gentle pace. The tone of a mother who sees the grace in a moment before it passes.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと優しいゴーストの絵本読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I read that picture book about the kind ghost.
lines.style: Content and settled. Slower pace than the first line—he's moved into recall, not just excitement. Warmth without urgency. A child satisfied by what happened.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがオーソドックスな日本食を作って下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad made that classic Japanese dinner for everyone.
lines.style: Calm observation. The tone of a mother naming something steady and dependable. Warm but grounded. No fanfare—just the simple love of provision.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「家族のスピリットが宝物」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me that family spirit is our most precious treasure.
lines.style: Hushed, reverent. This is the line where the child has understood something larger than himself. Slower, deliberate delivery. Tender without being performed. The quiet wisdom of a six-year-old who has been truly heard.
